notes.title: Cities XXL: Patch #4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The patch #4 for Cities XXL is now automatically available on Steam.

[h1]Patch #4 release notes (19/03/2015):[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
- Fixed different types of crash.
- Added camera sensitivity in Options>Miscellaneous.
- Various minor bug fixes.

[b]Community[/b]
- Added a Dependencies field in the UGC Manager.
You can now specify if your mods need one or multiple dependencies to work with the Published File ID.
At the game launch, it can detect the missing dependencies. If so, the game will inform you that it will quit and will subscribe automatically for you the missing mods.

For example, your mod need the Cities XXL Community Mod and the XL Nation Furniture Dependency Pack.
You can find the Published File ID from the url:

steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=347768408
steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=381064686

So type 347768408 and 381064686 in the dependencies field.

We invite all modders to update their mods with the dependency information. And please do not forget to also specify it in the description of your mod.

Best regards, 
Focus Home Interactive

-------------

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/313010/discussions/0/618453594748561915/]Patch #1[/url]

notes.title: Cities XXL: Patch #3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
 
The patch #3 for Cities XXL is now automatically available on Steam.
 
[h1]Patch #3 release notes (26/02/2015):[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
- Fixed different types of crash.
- Fixed camera collision with the ground.
- Added VSync option.
- Added a hide/unhide button for the building filter panel.
- You can now move on the map with WASD or ZQSD.
- Various minor bug fixes.

[b]Community[/b]
- Added a change note field before to upload a Workshop Item with the UGC Manager.
[u]Note[/u]: all text fields in the UGC Manager are limited to ASCII characters only. ([url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ASCII]http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ASCII[/url])

Best regards,
Focus Home Interactive

notes.title: Cities XXL: Patch #2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
 
The patch #2 for Cities XXL is now automatically available on Steam.
 
[h1]Patch #2 release notes (18/02/2015):[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
- Fixed stretched UI (information and zoning panel).
- Fixed the "Remove cheat tokens" that didn't work under specific condition.
- Removed wrong version number.
- Various minor bug fixes.

[b]Achievement[/b]
- Tweaked achievements:

Budget
Bronze: Own a budget of 500000 (requires a positive balance).
Silver: Own a budget of 10000000 (requires a positive balance).
Gold: Own a budget of 100000000 (requires a positive balance).

Trader
Bronze: Trade 1 token (requires a positive balance).
Silver: Trade 100 tokens (requires a positive balance).
Gold: Trade 200 tokens (requires a positive balance).

Bus
Bronze: Own 1 bus route (requires a positive balance).
Silver: Own 10 bus routes (requires a positive balance).
Gold: Own 50 bus routes (requires a positive balance).

Builder
Bronze: Own 1000 buildings in your town (requires a positive balance).
Silver: Own 3000 buildings in your town (requires a positive balance).
Gold: Own 5000 buildings in your town (requires a positive balance).

Let's ride!
Bronze: Own 10 kilometers of roads.
Silver: Own 50 kilometers of roads.
Gold: Own 200 kilometers of roads.

[b]Community[/b]
- Added the official tag list for the UGC Manager.

[b]Support[/b]
- Added an error message when a modded building need a dependency mod at the game launch.
 
Best regards,
Focus Home Interactive

-------------

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/313010/discussions/0/618453594748561915/]Patch #1[/url]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Cities XXL
notes.notes:
Cities XXL is Now Available on Steam! Owners of previous Cities XL games get 50% off*

Design, build, and manage the world’s largest and most diverse cities in Cities XXL. Bigger and better than ever before with a more powerful game engine and new interface, become the mayor of your very own sprawling metropolis. With town-planning including home locations, retail plots, offices, industry and infrastructure across 47 architectural styles and 1000+ buildings, manage the happiness of your city’s denizens, with leisure activities, landmarks, and ecology and pollution management. With new structures, but also all-new ecological buildings and upgrades, such as the park-and-ride, electric car dealership, and bike hire, Cities XXL offers a greener approach!

Manage the economy by sharing resources between all of your cities across over 65 maps (including new landscapes and environments) throughout the ‘Cities Planet’: trade anything from waste management to oil, fuel, and water – even holidaymakers and workers. Finally, create, share and download user crafted content via the Steam Workshop – an endless supply of user-curated content. From scenic villages to economic powerhouses, build, manage, and grow the city of your dreams in Cities XXL.

*Offer ends Feb 12 at 10am Pacific

notes.title: First Of The SimCityNots: CitiesXXL Out Today
notes.notes:
People said that EA’s most recent SimCity had cities that were too small. People said that Focus Home Interactive’s Cities XL Platinum was quite good but quickly ground to a halt once your city reached a certain size, and long before you’d filled the limits of the landscape available to you. What will people say about Cities XXL, the latest iteration of the series which is out today? I will let you know once my copy unlocks, but the launch trailer below looks nice for now.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: CITIES XXL: THE LAUNCH TRAILER!
notes.notes:
[b][i]The Supersized City-Builder now available for download! [/i][/b]

The Cities XL franchise returns with [b]Cities XXL[/b], now available for download and next week in stores! [b]Cities XXL[/b] is a bigger, more complete [b]city-builder[/b] pushing the city limits to the edge of your imagination. Running on an [b]improved game engine[/b] for [b]enhanced performances[/b], [b]Cities XXL[/b] offers classic and [b]extended city-building content[/b], including [b]over 1000 buildings and structures[/b], [b]over 65 maps[/b] including [b]new landscapes and environments[/b], and [b]ecological features[/b] making [b]Cities XXL[/b] the 'greenest' Cities XL game yet. 

[b][u][i]With the game being made available today, it's worth noting that owners of a previous version of Cities XL may still benefit from the special -50% offer we prepared for them - all details about this offer on the game's Steam page.[/i] [/u][/b]

Discover now an ultimate peek at what you can expect in Cities XXL with [b][u][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gIKp_1Qs7ZM]its launch trailer[/url][/u][/b]!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gIKp_1Qs7ZM

Already offering huge content, [b]Cities XXL[/b] also integrates [b][u][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/313010/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url][/u][/b] - a hub containing additional content curated by players - with nearly 50 new buildings available for download for free at the game's release. The Steam Workshop will be filled regularly by creative players: new buildings, new functionalities. supplying you with virtually unlimited content for Cities XXL!

[b][i]Focus Home Interactive[/i][/b]
